Acceptable Use Policy — APIbase legal APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Acceptable Use Policy v1.3 1. Allowed categories Digital goods and content; online courses and education; software and SaaS subscriptions (terms in Merchant Agreement section 10); services (consulting, design, development); ordinary physical goods (clothing, footwear, sporting goods, furniture, unrestricted electronics, books, home goods); tours and excursions without air tickets; accommodation and service booking (no timeshares). 2. Prohibited categories This is the single list of prohibited categories for merchant storefronts. The machine-readable copy is published at /legal/prohibited-categories.json; the block below is kept equal to it. Where the Terms of Service (section 5, platform tool calls) or the Moderation Policy also apply, the stricter rule wins; the Moderation Policy describes enforcement, not categories. anything illegal; drugs and analogues; counterfeit goods and IP infringement; stolen goods, forged documents; hate and violence propaganda; dangerous, explosive or radioactive materials; pyramid schemes, MLM, get-rich-quick; gambling and games of chance for a prize; alcohol, tobacco, vapes; pharma, prescription, telemedicine, pseudo-pharma and supplements with medical claims; weapons and weapon parts; cannabis and CBD; adult content and services; financial services (loans, brokers, BNPL, transfers, currency and crypto exchange, wallets, stored value, gift cards); insurance; dating; commercial airlines, cruises, timeshares; charity, crowdfunding, politics; precious metals and high-value jewelry; marketplaces, aggregators, payment intermediaries; negative options and unclear trial periods; telemarketing; remote tech support; credit repair and debt services; traffic and engagement trading; resale without added value; dropshipping 'advice'. 3. Deceptive practices Forbidden: false or misleading product descriptions or prices; fake reviews or statistics; listing goods the merchant does not have or cannot deliver; changing price or terms after a quote is paid; collecting data beyond what the order needs; misleading buyers about who the seller is. 4. Restricted countries A merchant whose entity is registered in one of these countries is not onboarded (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2): CU, IR, KP, RU, BY, CN, DZ, BD, EG, IQ, MA, NP, QA, TN, TR, ID, VN, KW, SY, SA, OM, MK, VE, MM, AF Sign-ups from some IP addresses, countries and regions may be refused. Payout wallets on the OFAC SDN list are refused. Terms · Privacy · Contact · Legal · GitHub
